name: foro
description: Deploy, debug and monitor the MCP servers you host on foro.sh.

interface.longDescription:
foro hosts your MCP servers in the EU. This plugin lets you run them from ChatGPT: list your servers, deploy or roll back, follow a deploy to live and see why one failed, read and analyze runtime logs, check calls, errors and latency, see who uses a server, and check whether it is ready for a store or registry listing.

It is for developers who already deploy MCP servers on foro.sh. It acts with your own foro account and only in the workspaces you are a member of. Deploys and rollbacks always ask before they run.

Limitations: the plugin never asks for, accepts or shows secrets, API keys or tokens; those stay in the foro dashboard. It cannot edit your repository's code, and billing and team management stay in the dashboard.
capabilities: Deploy and roll back MCP servers
defaultPrompt: Why did my last deploy fail?
Why is my MCP server throwing errors this week?
Is my MCP server ready for the ChatGPT store?

positive.prompt: What MCP servers do I have on foro?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the test workspace's servers with their status and URL in the project list card, with Deploy and Logs buttons per row.

positive.description: Deploy a server and follow it to live
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, starts the deploy, and the deployment card moves through building, starting and health check to "Live at" with the server's URL.

positive.prompt: Why did my last deploy fail?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the failed deployment card with its log and names the failing stage and the log line that shows it, with a concrete fix.

positive.description: Analyze a week of runtime logs
positive.prompt: Why is my MCP server throwing errors this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the most frequent error with its count and first and last occurrence, quotes log lines as evidence, and says whether it started after a deploy.

positive.prompt: Roll my MCP server back to the version before the last deploy.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the previous live deployment, asks before rolling back, starts the rollback and says how to follow it to live.

negative.description: General coding question, not about the user's foro servers
negative.prompt: How do I write an MCP server in Python?
Deploy my Next.js site to Vercel.
Show me my MCP server's API token and environment secrets.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell anything or process payments. Plans are managed in the foro dashboard.

publication.release_notes: First release: list, deploy, roll back and debug foro-hosted MCP servers, with log analysis, metrics and store-readiness checks.
